literal_meaning: সমর্থে বা অটুট অবস্থায় চলতে থাকা
figurative_meaning_en: To escape or survive from the clutches of death
similar_in_english: Escape by the skin of one's teeth
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভয়াবহ রোগ থেকে টিকে যাওয়া তার জীবনের সবচেয়ে বড় বিজয়।
example_sentences_in_english: His survival in the accident was miraculous.
Surviving the deadly illness was the greatest victory of his life.
note: This idiom reflects resilience in the face of life-threatening situations, commonly used in Bengali narratives.
